title: Ten questions to ask your 2026 ads before planning 2027
hook: Your 2026 ad account already holds most of next year's plan. Ten questions to get it out.
caption:
Your 2026 ad account already holds most of next year's plan. Ten questions to get it out.

Planning usually starts from targets and a blank calendar. A better start is what last year's ads already taught you about buyers, openings, people on screen and spend.

There are two questions for each, and two more on what the team now knows.

Answer them on one page and bring it to your 2027 planning meeting.

Save this, and read Decoded #9 for what a year of ads taught us. Link in bio.

cta: Save the questions; read Decoded #9 via link in bio

slides.headline: *10 questions* to ask your 2026 ads before you plan 2027
slides.sub: Bring the answers to your planning meeting.

slides.headline: *Who* did we really sell to?
items: Which buyer did our best ads speak to?
Which buyer did we never make an ad for?

slides.headline: What *stopped the scroll*?
items: Which first shots held people longest?
Which opening did we repeat until it wore out?

slides.headline: *Who* on screen earned their place?
items: Which faces sold across more than one ad?
Which did we keep using out of habit?

slides.headline: Where did the *spend* go?
items: Which ads took the most spend, and did they earn it?
What did we cut too late, or too early?

slides.headline: What do we *know now*?
items: What do we believe today that we did not in January?

slides.headline: Ten answers, one page. *Take it into planning.*
slides.sub: Decoded #9 covers what a year of ads taught us. Link in bio.
